:::{#def-indefinite-integral}
#### Indefinite integral

The **indefinite integral** of $f$ is the family of all antiderivatives
(@def-antiderivative) of $f$:

$$\int f(x)\,dx = F(x) + C$$

where $F$ is any one antiderivative of $f$
and $C$ is an arbitrary constant of integration.

[@larsonCalc11e, Section 4.1, pp. 248--249]

:::
